mechanism: Incompatible genome interpretation can disrupt expression
falsification_control: Compare independent variation in copy and interpretation fidelity.

mechanism: Parasite interactions can alter evolutionary outcomes and persistence
falsification_control: Compare otherwise matched conditions with and without parasite interactions.

mechanism: Special treatment for bound molecules can favor unproductive persistence
falsification_control: Compare binding-dependent and uniform decay, assessing viable offspring.

mechanism: Length-dependent decay can favor costly oversized programs
falsification_control: Compare length-neutral and length-dependent conditions at matched compute.

mechanism: Intermediate processor changes can be strongly conserved by selection
falsification_control: Compare fixed and mutable interpreter structures under similar conditions.

mechanism: An observer's new network classification is not an internally evolved instruction
falsification_control: Classify the same records with alternative preregistered scientific models.

mechanism: Researcher-specified incentives can determine selected behaviors
falsification_control: Assess new capabilities after externally assigned novelty selection is disabled.

mechanism: Repeated causal copying alone does not prove adaptive inherited novelty
falsification_control: Require an inherited new function under held-out ecological conditions.

mechanism: Resource scaling can confound evolutionary activity measurements
falsification_control: Compare resource-adjusted and raw activity with independent function measures.

mechanism: Visual novelty scores can improve without independent ecological gains
falsification_control: Use external held-out function tests with no image score feedback.

mechanism: Raw cumulative activity can diverge from neutral-adjusted novelty
falsification_control: Predefine shadow-neutral controls and multiple levels of lineage identity.

mechanism: Artificial resource replenishment may hide lack of self-maintenance
falsification_control: Separate finite-resource maintenance from externally held-constant inputs.
